nominal_10ms_per_received_sample.assumption: Exactly100Hz nominal device cadence; only received valid samples counted. Missing samples not invented; calibration/cadence error not bounded.

host_receipt_frame_mean_trapezoid.assumption: Trapezoid of frame-mean current/power at host receipt times; split at invalid frames or gaps>0.2s. No gap interpolation. Host buffering/timing may bias results.

integral_estimates.precision_claim: Approximate model estimates, not exact physical energy. No offset subtraction or missing-data compensation.

meter_raw_proof.raw_to_samples_proof: Every raw read reparsed with CRC; every decoded sample, zero, index, and timestamp matches JSONL exactly. Invalid raw frames produce no samples.

limitations: This derivative requires region 2 equality; watchdog regions 0/1 are observed and final all-three restoration is separate.
New quiet200 RAM fixture; does not reclassify prior 300-second failures.
READY-to-READY includes RAM upload, host ACK delay, reset/reconnect and panel preparation.
Four samples share each real host frame receipt; no device timestamps or exact dropped count.
Trapezoid frame mean(U*I) with linear boundary clipping; no bridge across invalid frame or >0.2s gap.
Nominal10ms/sample integral is sensitivity only, not a confidence interval or exact energy.
Two cycles, equal weights and min/max; no precision, steady-state or causal IRQ claim.
Complete USB assembly at meter input; 10uA resolution is not verified absolute calibration.
